hows.text: Approach 1: Implement a robust slice with an explicit offset and count, ensuring the final page correctly includes the remainder of the items rather than dropping the last one.
hows.reason: This directly addresses the missing last item issue by guaranteeing the total count is respected and the final slice is correctly calculated.

hows.text: Approach 2: Audit the page numbering logic to ensure it correctly maps to the calculated slice boundaries, verifying that page numbers align with the actual data retrieval without skipping items.
hows.reason: This targets the node goal of page numbers looking correct while fixing the underlying slice logic that causes items to be skipped.
